items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: But Charlotte Bonnet and a few others played in tune. Charlotte Bonnet and a few others played.

ctx.x: He was on soprano by the time he went with Cook wasn't he? I think probably he was.

I thought he went with a listener on his clarinet but I thought, I'm not sure. But he set a good style for clarinet oh years ago. A good style for clarinet. And I don't know, maybe he saw so many clarinet players come along and he said, I'll take this soprano. And he took it and made God rich of it. But I had a lot of soprano saxophone. I just don't like to tell them what they had. Well of course I'm me about what does me, what I like or dislike. But Bache did some with it all right. But Charlotte Bonnet and a…
You've heard Johnny Hodges play soprano.
